RC5AtJYdnCyVR8_m4Cvx4g.en: Japan's outbreak continues to rise. In week 5 (26 January–1 February), the average number of sentinel reports of infectious gastroenteritis was 9.42 cases, the highest for the same period in the past 10 years; the pathogen is mainly norovirus. South Korea's outbreak continues to climb: it reported 709 cases in week 5 (25–31 January), the highest in five years, with children aged 0–6 years accounting for the largest share. In Hong Kong, food poisoning incidents have increased since January this year. Between 18 January and 9 February, 37 food poisoning incidents were reported cumulatively, affecting 115 people, of which 33 (89%) were linked to norovirus, with 101 cases in total. The suspected source of infection is oysters produced in South Korea, France and Ireland.

VI6u8gPzD6MRhNtM9UdgMw.zh: 疫情更新:  今年第3週(1/12-18)全球陽性率上升至3.49%,其中歐洲及東南亞區署陽性率明顯增加。 中國疫情上升,今年第5週(1/26-2/1)門診陽性率上升至2.3%,疫情已連續2週上升,變異株以NB.1.8.1占多數。 韓國疫情上升,今年第5週新增59例住院病例,陽性率略降至1.3%,變異株以NB.1.8.1占多數。  評估與建議: 全球近期流行變異株占比以XFG最高。WHO於2/2發布COVID-19全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,6%「有症狀病例」出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計畫》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
VI6u8gPzD6MRhNtM9UdgMw.en: Epidemic update: In week 3 of this year (12–18 January), the global positivity rate rose to 3.49%, with notable increases in the WHO European and South-East Asian regions. China's epidemic is rising: the outpatient positivity rate in week 5 (26 January–1 February) rose to 2.3%, the epidemic has risen for two consecutive weeks, and NB.1.8.1 is the majority variant. South Korea's epidemic is rising: 59 new hospitalized cases were reported in week 5, the positivity rate fell slightly to 1.3%, and NB.1.8.1 is the majority variant. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of globally circulating variants. WHO published its global long-term rapid risk assessment for COVID-19 (9th edition) on 2 February, which rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

AfzotMbkZpUwLv3w55skKg.zh: 韓國疫情更新,今年第4週(1/18-24)報告616例病例,疫情與前一週相當,為近5年同期最高,嬰幼兒(0-6歲)佔所有患者的39.6%;當局呼籲病患於症狀緩解2天後,再返回校園或職場。
AfzotMbkZpUwLv3w55skKg.en: South Korea's update: in week 4 (18–24 January), 616 cases were reported, similar to the previous week and the highest for the same period in the past five years. Infants and young children aged 0–6 years accounted for 39.6% of all patients. Authorities advise patients to return to school or work only 2 days after symptoms ease.

smOxUtQm9eXHd8xUzodEIQ.zh: 新加坡疫情呈上升趨勢,今年第2週(1/11-17)平均每日新增18例,為2025年10月以來最高,惟仍低於去年同期或去年最高點;越南疫情趨緩,第3週病例數較前4週平均下降19.8%;韓國第3週(1/11-17)就診率為千分之1.5,較前1週下降,惟仍高於去年同期。
smOxUtQm9eXHd8xUzodEIQ.en: Singapore's situation is rising. In week 2 (11–17 January) this year, an average of 18 new cases were reported per day, the highest since October 2025, though still below the same period last year and last year's peak. Viet Nam's situation has eased; in week 3, case numbers fell 19.8% compared with the average of the previous four weeks. In South Korea, the outpatient visit rate in week 3 (11–17 January) was 1.5 per 1,000, down from the previous week but still higher than the same period last year.

jNCpEU5dg46zSQL5Fmu60A.zh: 韓國疫情更新,今年第3週(1/11-17)報告617例病例,疫情已連續10週上升,且為5年同期最高,其中6歲以下兒童占51.1%,其次為7-18歲(占19.3%);當局呼籲病患於症狀緩解2天後,再返回校園或職場。
jNCpEU5dg46zSQL5Fmu60A.en: South Korea update: in week 3 (11–17 January), 617 cases were reported. Cases have risen for 10 consecutive weeks and are the highest for the same period in five years. Children under 6 years accounted for 51.1% of cases, followed by those aged 7–18 years (19.3%). Authorities advise patients to return to school or work only 2 days after symptoms ease.

0sxS5AJ4O4cWa_iS_65WOw.zh: 韓國疫情自2025年11月起持續攀升,今年迄第2週止已新增548例病例,為近5年同期最高,其中6歲以下病患占約4成;該國疫情好發於11-3月,主要感染源為受汙染的地下水或海鮮,亦可能透過接觸病患的飛沫或嘔吐物感染,當局呼籲注意個人衛生,尤其托兒機構等應加強衛生防護措施。 中國廣東省佛山市1/17報告某高中群聚事件,累計103例病例,迄無重症或死亡病例,當局已展開調查,加強衛生教育與清消;另中國有78-93%的諾羅疫情發生於校園,疫情流行於10-3月。 日本岩手縣1/20報告1起托嬰中心群聚事件,累計22例病例,包括21名幼童及1名工作人員,其中有4例檢驗呈陽性,發病日介於1/7-18。
0sxS5AJ4O4cWa_iS_65WOw.en: South Korea's situation has risen continuously since November 2025, with 548 new cases reported through week 2 of this year, the highest for the same period in the past five years. About 40% of patients were under 6 years old. Outbreaks typically occur from November to March, mainly from contaminated groundwater or seafood, and infection can also occur through respiratory droplets or contact with patients' vomit. Authorities urge attention to personal hygiene, and childcare facilities in particular should strengthen hygiene and protection measures. On 17 January, Foshan City in Guangdong Province, China, reported a cluster at a senior high school, with 103 cumulative cases; no severe or fatal cases have been recorded. Authorities have launched an investigation and are strengthening health education and disinfection. In China, 78–93% of norovirus outbreaks occur in schools, and outbreaks are prevalent from October to March. On 20 January, Iwate Prefecture in Japan reported a cluster at a nursery centre, with 22 cumulative cases, including 21 young children and 1 staff member; 4 tested positive, with onset dates between 7 and 18 January.

-aVjBLvJ2mn7hmGyn7pgmA.zh: 日本2025年截至第50週累計報告逾1.3萬例確定病例,以東京都3,264例為多,其次為大阪府(1,637例)及愛知縣(818例),另愛媛縣(155例)為歷年最高,當局已提供電話諮詢及免費匿名篩檢服務,並呼籲民眾應正確使用保險套,疑感染者應立即接受檢測。 韓國2025年截至11月累計報告2,036例確定病例,年齡層以20-30歲為主,當局持續宣導安全性行為及早期檢測之重要性;該國自2024年起梅毒由抽樣監測調整為全面通報,2024年累計報告2,790例。
-aVjBLvJ2mn7hmGyn7pgmA.en: Japan reported more than 13,000 confirmed cases cumulatively in 2025 through week 50. The most were in Tokyo Metropolis (3,264), followed by Osaka Prefecture (1,637) and Aichi Prefecture (818). Ehime Prefecture (155) recorded its highest number on record. Authorities have provided telephone consultation and free anonymous screening services, urge people to use condoms correctly, and advise anyone with suspected infection to be tested immediately. South Korea reported 2,036 confirmed cases cumulatively through November 2025, mainly among those aged 20–30; authorities continue to promote safe sex and early testing. Since 2024, South Korea has changed syphilis reporting from sample-based surveillance to full notification; 2,790 cases were reported in 2024.

Yvtc16uVzW1NjXU8PvsTdw.zh: 韓國全羅南道於冬季疫情仍持續,由於全球暖化導致氣溫升高,當地2021-24年12月份病例數逐年上升,分別報告79、96、109及192例,當局呼籲於戶外活動採取預防措施避免蜱蟲叮咬。
Yvtc16uVzW1NjXU8PvsTdw.en: In Jeollanam-do province, South Korea, scrub typhus cases continue into winter. Authorities urge people to take precautions during outdoor activities to avoid tick bites.

5Whitu5ACKHqPcHlPplPdQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第48週(11/24-30)全球陽性率降至4.06%,其中非洲區署陽性率增加。 中國疫情略增,第50週(12/8-14)門診陽性率為0.5%,較前1週(0.3%)略增,住院陽性率亦上升,整體疫情仍於低點,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情於低點,第50週報告住院數降至99例,陽性率略升為2%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 英國疫情於低點波動,第50週實驗室監測陽性率降至1.9%,住院病例數亦下降,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,其中非洲區署呈上升;近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(63.6%),其次為NB.1.8.1(12.72%),新公告的BA.3.2占比提升至6.71%。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理;另WHO新冠疫苗委員會於12/18公告建議以單價LP.8.1作為推薦的疫苗抗原,且JN.1譜系(JN.1或KP.2)仍為合適的替代選項。
5Whitu5ACKHqPcHlPplPdQ.en: Situation update: global test positivity fell to 4.06% in week 48 of 2025 (24–30 November), although it rose in the African Region. China's situation rose slightly: outpatient test positivity was 0.5% in week 50 (8–14 December), up slightly from 0.3% the week before, and hospital test positivity also rose; overall the situation remains at a low level, and NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant. South Korea's situation is at a low level: hospital admissions fell to 99 in week 50 and test positivity rose slightly to 2%, with NB.1.8.1 the most common variant. The United Kingdom's situation fluctuates at a low level: laboratory surveillance test positivity fell to 1.9% in week 50, hospital admissions also declined, and XFG is the most common variant. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently declined, although it has risen in the African Region. XFG is currently the most common global variant (63.6%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12.72%), and the newly announced BA.3.2 has risen to 6.71%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat. In addition, the WHO COVID-19 vaccine committee announced on 18 December that monovalent LP.8.1 is recommended as the vaccine antigen, and the JN.1 lineage (JN.1 or KP.2) remains a suitable alternative option.

6LF4K4nG7wRKreqEpbBxMA.en: China reported 56,554 cases in weeks 49–50 (1–14 December), including 20 severe cases and no deaths. Case numbers fell 43% compared with the previous two weeks but remain 134% higher than the same period last year. In Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, the outbreak eased slightly, with 1,484 new cases in week 49, a 17% decrease from the previous week. In South Korea, the situation fluctuated; the outpatient visit positivity rate rose to 5.9 per 1,000 in week 49, higher than the same period over the past three years. In Thailand, the situation declined, with 848 cases reported cumulatively in week 50, lower than the same period last year.

4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.zh: WHO於12/10報告今(2025)年截至11/30,全球季節性流感自10月起活動度上升,目前全球流行以 A(H3N2) 為主,另自8月起,多國之K分支檢出率上升,北半球部分國家的流感季較往年提早,南半球部分國家的流感季節較往年延長。西太平洋區自10 月起活動度增加,日本及韓國提早進入流感季,紐西蘭及斐濟活動度處高峰或上升, GISAID資料顯示截至11/21,西太平洋區之病毒序列有89%為K分支;東南亞地區自6月上升,8月達高峰後趨緩,惟部分國家活動度仍偏高,另GISAID資料顯示泊爾、印度、泰國已檢出K分支;北美洲地區活動度上升,美國及加拿大K分支檢出率增加;歐洲地區部份國家第45-46 週陽性率超過10%,流感季較往年提前約4週開始,其中西歐較早上升,65 歲以上住院比例增加;WHO 評估全球流感活動度上升仍在預期範圍,流感病毒與其他呼吸道病毒共同流行,可能對醫療系統造成壓力,多國已檢出A(H3N2) K分支,目前證據未顯示K分支有致疾病嚴重度提升之情形,疫苗仍預期能降低重症風險。
4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.en: WHO reported on 10 December that, as of 30 November this year, global seasonal influenza activity has risen since October, with A(H3N2) currently predominant worldwide. Since August, detection of subclade K has increased in several countries. Some northern hemisphere countries' flu seasons began earlier than usual, and some southern hemisphere countries' seasons were longer than usual. In the Western Pacific Region, activity has increased since October, with Japan and South Korea entering the flu season early; New Zealand and Fiji are at or rising towards peak activity. GISAID data show that as of 21 November, 89% of virus sequences in the Western Pacific Region belonged to subclade K. In Southeast Asia, activity rose from June, peaked in August and then eased, although activity remains high in some countries; GISAID data show subclade K has been detected in Nepal, India and Thailand. In North America, activity has risen, with increased subclade K detection in the United States and Canada. In some European countries, test positivity exceeded 10% in weeks 45–46; the flu season began about four weeks earlier than usual, with Western Europe rising first, and hospitalisation among people aged 65 and over has increased. WHO assesses that the rise in global influenza activity is within the expected range. Influenza viruses are circulating alongside other respiratory viruses, which may put pressure on health systems. Several countries have detected A(H3N2) subclade K. Current evidence does not show that subclade K causes more severe disease, and vaccines are still expected to reduce the risk of severe illness.

Sq1m_Pl2QuPJuY0kKiQCbA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第47週(11/17-23)全球陽性率略升至5.21%,其中東南亞區署陽性率增加。 WHO公告BA.3.2為監測中變異株(VUM),BA.3.2為Omicron BA.3的後代譜系,首例於2024年11/22檢出,截至今年11/9全球有7個國家提報86例BA.3.2序列資訊,在2025年第45週全球變異株中占1.7%,較第42週0.2%上升;WHO評估BA.3.2具顯著抗體逃脫能力,惟造成疾病嚴重度為低,整體評估風險為低,仍需持續監測。 韓國疫情於低點,第49週(11/30-12/6)報告住院降至106例,陽性率降為1.8%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 加拿大疫情從低點略升,第48週報告1,964例病例,陽性率略升至6.6%,各年齡層疫情皆上升,並以65歲以上為多,變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期略升,其中東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(59%),其次為NB.1.8.1(19%),新公告的BA.3.2占約5%。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。
Sq1m_Pl2QuPJuY0kKiQCbA.en: Situation update: global test positivity rose slightly to 5.21% in week 47 of 2025 (17–23 November), with increases in the South-East Asia Region. WHO has designated BA.3.2 as a variant under monitoring (VUM). BA.3.2 is a descendant lineage of Omicron BA.3; it was first detected on 22 November 2024. As of 9 November this year, 7 countries had submitted 86 BA.3.2 sequences. In week 45 of 2025, BA.3.2 accounted for 1.7% of global variants, up from 0.2% in week 42. WHO assesses that BA.3.2 has significant antibody escape, but causes low disease severity, and its overall risk is assessed as low; continued monitoring is needed. South Korea's situation is at a low level: hospital admissions fell to 106 in week 49 (30 November–6 December), and test positivity fell to 1.8%, with NB.1.8.1 the most common variant. Canada's situation rose slightly from a low: 1,964 cases were reported in week 48, and test positivity rose slightly to 6.6%. Cases increased in all age groups, mainly among those aged 65 and over, with XFG the most common variant. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently risen slightly, with an upward trend in the South-East Asia Region. XFG is currently the most common global variant (59%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19%), and the newly announced BA.3.2 accounts for about 5%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat.

Sl8VkzOfz7xQObuGJc98Lw.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,第48週(11/24-30)新增1,484例病例,較前4週平均增加0.9%,今年迄今累計達34,127例,該病每年流行高峰期為9-12月;中國疫情自高點下降,11月報告26萬9,337例病例,其中1例死亡,雖較10月疫情(37萬例)略降,惟仍為去年同期4.5倍;韓國疫情下降,第48週就診陽性率5.2‰,仍高於近3年同期;泰國疫情下降,第49週累計報告820例,低於去年同期。
Sl8VkzOfz7xQObuGJc98Lw.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, continues to rise: 1,484 new cases were reported in week 48 (24–30 November), an increase of 0.9% over the average of the previous four weeks. China's situation has declined from its peak: 269,337 cases were reported in November, including 1 death. Although this is slightly lower than October (about 370,000 cases), it is 4.5 times the same period last year. United States: the epidemic is declining. Deaths fell from about 1,000 per week in early January to about 200 per week in May. Positivity in week 20 (11–17 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest shares; NB.1.8.1 is predicted to become the dominant variant. Canada: the epidemic is at a low point. Weekly cases fell from nearly 4,000 in January to about 500 in May. Positivity in week 22 (25–31 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for high shares. Europe: 11 countries are at the epidemic peak. Outpatient positivity in week 23 (1–7 June) was 10.2%, slightly lower than the previous peak of 10.9%, but hospital positivity reached 5.9%, the highest this year. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest share and LP.8.1 the second highest. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

DdqymFdLXsF-DZ3ezME1Bg.zh: 韓國自5月發生2起忠清北道區機構群聚事件後,又新增2起群聚事件,分別於世宗特別行政區及全羅北道扶安郡,截至6/13累計4起208例病例,感染源皆為機構提供之麵包類產品,當局已召回產品,並監測相關機構。
DdqymFdLXsF-DZ3ezME1Bg.en: After two facility cluster outbreaks in Chungcheongbuk-do in May, two more cluster outbreaks have been reported, in Sejong Special Self-Governing City and in Buan County, Jeollabuk-do. As of 13 June, 4 cluster outbreaks with 208 cumulative cases have been reported. The source in every case was bread products supplied by the facilities. Authorities have recalled the products and are monitoring the relevant facilities.

RzxjqEviDVDOzw1G0PXMNQ.zh: 亞洲國家第22-24週(5/25-6/14)疫情更新,中國疫情上升,5月新增5.2萬餘例病例;日本疫情緩升,定醫平均病例數0.19,該國今年截至6/19累計報告5例Echo11型病例;越南河內市報告單週報告新增112例病例,該市自今年截至6/13已累計報告2,839例,較去年同期增加;新加坡疫情自高峰下降,平均單日新增33例病例,惟仍高於去年同期;韓國疫情持平,就診陽性率2‰;香港疫情持平,就診陽性率為0.3‰。
RzxjqEviDVDOzw1G0PXMNQ.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 22–24 (25 May–14 June): China's epidemic is rising, with more than 52,000 new cases in May. Japan's epidemic is rising slowly, with an average of 0.19 cases per sentinel clinic. Japan has reported 5 Echo 11 virus cases so far this year, as of 19 June. In Hanoi, Viet Nam, 112 new cases were reported in one week, and the city has cumulatively reported 2,839 cases so far this year as of 13 June, an increase over the same period last year. Singapore's epidemic has declined from its peak, with an average of 33 new cases per day, still higher than the same period last year. South Korea's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 2‰. Hong Kong's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 0.3‰.

kgfiy00HE0N6tXESuY0YCg.zh: 巴西首都聖保羅市今年截至6/11,報告1,754例,其中175例死亡,相較去年同期983例病例(77例死亡)為多,並以H1N1為主,當地高風險族群疫苗覆蓋率僅約40%,遠低於目標(90%),當局於公共運輸點設立接種站,加強接種工作。 韓國自去年12/20發布流感流行警告,於今年第1週99.8例達高峰後下降,春季再次上升,於第15週達峰(21.6例)後持續下降,已連續3週低於閾(8.6例),宣布解除流行警告。本流感季初期以A型為主,惟今年春季後改為B型。當局表示雖已解除警告,惟仍須注意夏季可能爆發新冠疫情。
kgfiy00HE0N6tXESuY0YCg.en: São Paulo city, Brazil, reported 1,754 cases and 175 deaths from the start of this year to 11 June, up from 983 cases (77 deaths) in the same period last year. The main subtype is H1N1. Vaccination coverage in high-risk groups is only about 40%, far below the 90% target, and authorities have set up vaccination stations at public transport points to strengthen vaccination. South Korea issued an influenza epidemic warning on 20 December last year. After peaking at 99.8 in week 1 of this season, cases fell, rose again in spring, and peaked at 21.6 in week 15 before declining. Having been below the threshold of 8.6 for 3 consecutive weeks, the warning has been lifted. Influenza A predominated early in the season, but after spring it shifted to influenza B. Authorities say that although the warning has been lifted, a COVID-19 outbreak may still occur in summer.

7cmehfMBNMtH0FJ7uRmZ_A.zh: 亞洲國家第21-23週(5/18-6/7)疫情更新,韓國就診陽性率為2.3‰,為今年最高點,惟仍顯著低於過去2年同期;新加坡疫情自高峰趨緩,平均單日新增37例病例;日本定醫平均病例數0.16,未進入流行期;香港疫情持平,就診陽性率為0.3‰。
7cmehfMBNMtH0FJ7uRmZ_A.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 21–23 (18 May–7 June): South Korea's clinic positivity was 2.3‰, the highest this year, though still significantly lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Singapore's epidemic has eased from its peak, with an average of 37 new cases per day. Japan's sentinel average was 0.16 cases, and its epidemic has not entered the epidemic period. Hong Kong's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 0.3‰.

QplAjJIAW8GVPS1guez-wg.zh: 韓國今年截至5/24累計報告3,800餘例,較去年同期增加2.5倍,上次發生大規模疫情為2017年,報告逾2.2萬例,該國每3-4年發生一次大規模疫情,惟新冠疫情期間因各項防護措施中斷流行週期,可能為今年病例數大幅增加原因之一。
QplAjJIAW8GVPS1guez-wg.en: South Korea reported more than 3,800 cases as of 24 May this year, an increase of 2.5 times over the same period last year. The last large-scale outbreak was in 2017, when more than 22,000 cases were reported. The country has large-scale outbreaks every 3–4 years, but during the COVID-19 period, various protective measures interrupted the epidemic cycle, which may be one reason for the sharp rise in cases this year.

CaWNoaZvVY8RUhv96ekrTg.zh: 亞洲國家第20-21週(5/11-24)疫情更新,新加坡疫情逐漸降溫,平均單日新增47例病例,低於去年同期(50例);日本定醫平均病例數0.18,為今年最高,惟尚未進入流行期;韓國就診陽性率為1.7‰,較前週(2.2‰)略降;香港處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.3‰;中國第19-20週(5/5-18)新增約1.9萬例病例,較前兩週上升26%,惟低於過去3年同期。
CaWNoaZvVY8RUhv96ekrTg.en: Update on Asian countries for weeks 20–21 (11–24 May): in Singapore the outbreak is gradually cooling, with an average of 47 new cases per day, below the 50 cases in the same period last year. Japan's average number of cases per sentinel clinic was 0.18, the highest this year, but the country has not yet entered an epidemic period. Korea's positivity rate among clinic visits was 1.7‰, slightly down from 2.2‰ the previous week. Hong Kong is at a low point, with a positivity rate among clinic visits of 0.3‰. China reported about 19,000 new cases in weeks 19–20 (5–18 May), up 26% from the previous two weeks but lower than the same period in the past three years.

6oUrMWqnv_KRGN9IKSuzmg.zh: 亞洲國家第19-20週(5/4-5/17)疫情更新,新加坡疫情仍處高點,平均單日新增49例病例,高於去年同期(33例);韓國就診陽性率為1.1‰,較前週(0.9‰)略升;香港處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.1‰;日本定醫平均病例數0.08,與前週(0.09)相當,尚未進入流行期;中國3月新增約1.2萬例病例,較去年同期下降34%。
6oUrMWqnv_KRGN9IKSuzmg.en: Update on Asian countries for weeks 19–20 (4–17 May): Singapore's outbreak remains at a high level, with an average of 49 new cases per day, higher than the 33 cases in the same period last year. Korea's clinic-visit positivity rate was 1.1‰, slightly up from 0.9‰ the previous week. Hong Kong is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.1‰. Japan's average sentinel clinic case count was 0.08, similar to the previous week (0.09), and it has not yet entered an epidemic period. China reported about 12,000 new cases in March, a 34% decrease from the same period last year.

mAMotVJwrxwOa_Mj7ctetQ.zh: 亞洲國家第18-19週(4/27-6/3)疫情,新加坡疫情嚴峻,平均單日新增61例病例,為2020年以來最高;香港就診陽性率為0.4‰,與前週持平;日本定醫平均病例數0.09,與前週(0.1)相當,仍處疫情低點;韓國處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.9‰,較前週略升;泰國疫情下降,第15-16週(4/6-4/19)新增929例。
mAMotVJwrxwOa_Mj7ctetQ.en: Update on Asian countries for weeks 18–19 (27 April–3 June): Singapore's outbreak is severe, with an average of 61 new cases per day, the highest since 2020. Hong Kong's clinic-visit positivity rate was 0.4‰, unchanged from the previous week. Japan's average sentinel clinic case count was 0.09, similar to the previous week (0.1), and it remains at a low point. Korea is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.9‰, slightly up from the previous week. Thailand's outbreak is declining, with 929 new cases in weeks 15–16 (6–19 April).

gMIRLzui02Pe-GCKVDUkzA.zh: 日本今年截至5/7累計報告47例病例,高於去年同期(43例);韓國今年截至4/26累計報告399例病例,與去年同期(422例)相當。 美國加州洛杉磯郡今年截至3月累計報告29例病例,為去年同期2倍;此波疫情自2024年開始,累計165例病例,其中7例死亡,為10年來最高紀錄。
gMIRLzui02Pe-GCKVDUkzA.en: Japan reported 47 cases cumulatively this year as of 7 May, higher than the 43 cases in the same period last year. South Korea reported 399 cases cumulatively this year as of 26 April, comparable to the 422 cases in the same period last year. Los Angeles County, California, reported 29 cases cumulatively as of March this year, twice the number in the same period last year. A7hGUPk3-z_XyXx_ixA55g.zh: 亞洲國家第17-18週(4/20-5/3)疫情,新加坡疫情嚴峻,平均單日新增51例病例,高於2020-24年任一週病例數;日本定醫平均病例數0.1,較前週(0.07)增加,仍處疫情低點;韓國處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.7‰,較前週略降;香港就診陽性率為0.4‰,與前週持平。
A7hGUPk3-z_XyXx_ixA55g.en: Update on Asian countries for weeks 17–18 (20 April–3 May): Singapore's outbreak is severe, with an average of 51 new cases per day, higher than the weekly case count in any week of 2020–24. Japan's average sentinel clinic case count was 0.1, up from 0.07 the previous week, and it remains at a low point. South Korea is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.7‰, slightly down from the previous week. Hong Kong's clinic-visit positivity rate was 0.4‰, unchanged from the previous week.

1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.zh: 韓國今年迄今累計52例,病例數為去年同期的1.3倍,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關病例,感染國家以越南33例為多,另有烏茲別克/泰國/義大利各1例,超過60%的病例未接種疫苗或接種狀況不明,當局表示因新冠疫情後國際交流頻繁,且全球疫情持續,尤其是東南亞地區,由於持續有前往流行地區之病例輸入並造成傳播,需對境外移入風險保持警戒。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/1報告12起疫情,累計30州935例,其中121例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,北達科他州近期報告自2011年來首例;加拿大今年截至4/19共7省1,177例,以安大略省(993)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/6累計報告287例,為該省1987年以來最高;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)病例數遽增,今年迄今報告786例,並報告1例成年男性死亡案例,該國去年同期僅報告7例。 法國今年截至4/13累計報告427例,接近去(2024)年全年病例數(483),其中,全國近60%的省份報告病例,以1-4歲兒童為多,另報告58例併發症,9例於ICU治療,並報告1例成年死亡病例。
1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.en: South Korea has reported 52 cases so far this year, 1.3 times the same period last year. All cases were imported or linked to imported cases; the countries of infection were mainly Viet Nam with 33 cases, plus 1 each in Uzbekistan, Thailand and Italy. More than 60% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Authorities said that international exchange has been frequent since the COVID-19 pandemic and the global outbreak continues, especially in Southeast Asia; because cases continue to be imported from areas with outbreaks and cause transmission, vigilance against the risk of imported cases must be maintained. North America update: as of 1 May this year, the United States has reported 12 outbreaks, with 935 cases cumulatively across 30 states, including 121 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. North Dakota recently reported its first case since 2011. As of 19 April, Canada had 1,177 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (993); case numbers in Alberta have risen rapidly, with 287 cases reported cumulatively as of 6 May, the highest for the province since 1987. In Chihuahua State in northern Mexico, case numbers have surged, with 786 cases reported this year so far, including 1 adult male death; the country reported only 7 cases in the same period last year. France reported 427 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, close to last year's full-year total of 483. Nearly 60% of the country's provinces have reported cases, mainly among children aged 1–4. A total of 58 complications were reported, 9 of which were treated in the ICU, and 1 adult death was reported.

T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共8國於2025/2/17-4/28期間新增52起H5N1疫情,美國17起、韓國12起、英國11起、德國/波蘭各4起、匈牙利2起、孟加拉/丹麥各1起。 共2國於2025/3/17-4/11期間新增2起H5N5疫情,挪威/英國各1起。 日本於2025/4/25新增1起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,048 (17)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第17週計407個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、奧勒岡州、紐澤西州)5個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC於5月2日更新流感風險評估工具(IRAT),將兩種新H5N1病毒列入評估名單:A/California/147/2024(基因型B3.13)及A/Washington/239/2024(基因型D1.1),兩病毒均屬H5N1 2.3.4.4b群,並被評為「中度風險」,近於先前被評估之其他 H5N1病毒。 期刊於4/28評論,來自40多國專家呼籲各國應加強監測、增強生物安全及新興傳染病整備計畫,以應對H5N1流感威脅,美國自2024年迄今超過995起乳牛場疫情及至少70例人類病例,並包含多起重症及該國首例死亡病例,部分人類病例未曾接觸感染動物,顯示病毒可能發生適應,並具有人際傳播潛力,另病毒持續於野鳥、家禽及被狩獵候鳥中傳播,亦增加人類及家畜風險。持續投入人畜監測資源,即時分享現地異常資訊及病毒基因學資料,對於掌握病毒動態至關重要。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,656起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 8 countries reported 52 new H5N1 outbreaks between 17 February and 28 April 2025: the United States 17, South Korea 12, the United Kingdom 11, Germany and Poland 4 each, Hungary 2, and Bangladesh and Denmark 1 each. A total of 2 countries reported 2 new H5N5 outbreaks between 17 March and 11 April 2025: Norway and the United Kingdom 1 each. Japan reported 1 new H3N8 outbreak on 25 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,048 (17) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 17, 407 sampling sites provided test reports, and 5 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Oregon and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: on 2 May the US CDC updated its Influenza Risk Assessment Tool (IRAT), adding two new H5N1 viruses to the assessment list: A/California/147/2024 (genotype B3.13) and A/Washington/239/2024 (genotype D1.1). Both viruses belong to the H5N1 2.3.4.4b clade and were rated as moderate risk, close to other H5N1 viruses previously assessed. A journal commentary published on 28 April by experts from more than 40 countries called on countries to strengthen surveillance, enhance biosecurity and improve preparedness for emerging infectious diseases in response to the H5N1 threat. Since 2024 the US has reported more than 995 dairy herd outbreaks and at least 70 human cases, including several severe cases and the country's first death; some human cases had no contact with infected animals, suggesting the virus may be adapting and may have the potential for human-to-human transmission. The virus also continues to spread among wild birds, poultry and hunted migratory birds, increasing risks to humans and livestock. Continued investment in human and animal surveillance resources, and timely sharing of local abnormal information and viral genetic data, are essential for understanding virus dynamics. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,656 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

64D5XtZGfsUtOk7sQk9LSA.zh: 中國疫情持續,今年3月報告1,919例病例,較1、2月(月增約2,200例)下降,惟仍高於去年同期(1,624例);日本今年截至4/13累計報告42例病例,高於去年同期(28例);韓國今年截至4/24累計報告377例病例,與去年同期(381例)相當。 荷蘭於3月中旬報告24例病例,其中8例住院,病患發病日介於去(2024)年11月至今年2月,經當局調查疑感染源為超市的冷凍藍莓並提醒民眾不要食用該批產品。
64D5XtZGfsUtOk7sQk9LSA.en: China's outbreak continues: 1,919 cases were reported in March this year, down from January and February (a monthly increase of about 2,200 cases), but still higher than the same period last year (1,624 cases). Japan reported 42 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, higher than the 28 cases in the same period last year. South Korea reported 377 cases cumulatively this year as of 24 April, comparable to the 381 cases in the same period last year. The Netherlands reported 24 cases in mid-March, 8 of whom were hospitalized. The patients had onset between November 2024 and February this year. Investigation suggests the suspected source was frozen blueberries sold at supermarkets, and the public has been advised not to eat that batch of product.

YorZj01Tv2YuuRGCQyF7Zw.zh: 亞洲國家第16-17週(4/13-4/26)疫情,新加坡疫情上升,平均單日新增53例病例,已連續4週增加,且高於去年任一單週病例數;日本疫情處相對低點,定醫平均病例數0.07,較前週增加;韓國處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.8‰,與前週持平;香港處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.4‰。
YorZj01Tv2YuuRGCQyF7Zw.en: Update on Asian countries for weeks 16–17 (13–26 April): Singapore's outbreak is rising, with an average of 53 new cases per day, up for four consecutive weeks and higher than any single week last year. Japan's outbreak is at a relatively low point, with an average sentinel clinic case count of 0.07, up from the previous week. South Korea is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.8‰, unchanged from the previous week. Hong Kong is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.4‰.

aXp7XeXQ9zLYEdt7JkYEJA.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共10國於2025/1/7-4/23期間新增41起H5N1疫情,匈牙利13起、波蘭9起、越南7起、美國5起、瑞典2起、南韓/比利時/法國/芬蘭/立陶宛各1起。 日本於2025/4/11-4/24期間新增3起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,031 (10)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第16週計410個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、明蘇達、紐澤西)4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:外媒報導2024年H1N2豬流感研究,病毒於歐洲由禽類跨物種傳播至豬隻形成H1N2 1C譜系,自2011-24年間報告至少29例人類感染事件,其中近半數發生於2021年後。據調查顯示多數人對該病毒無免疫力,目前疫苗對該病毒保護效力較低;於動物實驗中,病毒可與人類呼吸道受體結合,且可在支氣管細胞中有效複製,具高度穩定性及高活性神經胺酸酶等特性,評估具有人際傳播潛力。惟現有證據顯示病毒致死率低,於豬隻感染症狀亦屬輕微,且未具高致病性,惟因具備人際傳播潛力及多數人無免疫能力,仍需持續納入監測及定期風險評估。 年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,601起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
aXp7XeXQ9zLYEdt7JkYEJA.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 10 countries reported 41 new H5N1 outbreaks between 7 January and 23 April 2025: Hungary 13, Poland 9, Viet Nam 7, the United States 5, Sweden 2, and one each in South Korea, Belgium, France, Finland and Lithuania. Japan reported 3 new H3N8 outbreaks between 11 and 24 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,031 (10) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 16, 410 sampling sites provided test reports, and 4 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Minnesota and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: foreign media reported on a 2024 study of H1N2 swine influenza. The virus was transmitted from birds to pigs in Europe, forming the H1N2 1C lineage; at least 29 human infection events were reported between 2011 and 2024, nearly half of them after 2021. Investigations show that most people have no immunity to this virus, and current vaccines offer less protection against it. In animal experiments, the virus could bind to human respiratory receptors and replicate efficiently in bronchial cells, and it showed high stability and highly active neuraminidase; it is assessed to have potential for human-to-human transmission. However, current evidence shows that the virus has a low fatality rate, causes mild symptoms in pigs, and is not highly pathogenic. Nevertheless, given its potential for human-to-human transmission and the fact that most people lack immunity, it should remain under continued surveillance and regular risk assessment. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,601 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

cGNF2RXTPMlUva8rZjjhJg.zh: 亞洲部分國家疫情上升,中國今年1、2月各報告約2,200例病例,為去年同期2倍;日本今年截至4/6累計報告41例病例,高於去年同期(26例);印度今年截至2/23累計報告10起群聚案件,高於去年同期(2起),病患多分布於南部喀拉拉邦(Kerala);韓國今年截至4/12累計報告360例病例,與去年同期(369例)相當;泰國今年截至3/22累計報告189例病例,第11-12週(3/9-3/22)疫情下降。
cGNF2RXTPMlUva8rZjjhJg.en: Outbreaks are rising in some Asian countries. China reported about 2,200 cases in each of January and February this year, double the same period last year. Japan reported 41 cases cumulatively this year as of 6 April, higher than the 26 in the same period last year. India reported 10 clusters cumulatively this year as of 23 February, higher than the 2 in the same period last year, with cases mainly in Kerala State in the south. South Korea reported 360 cases cumulatively this year as of 12 April, comparable to the 369 in the same period last year. Thailand reported 189 cases cumulatively this year as of 22 March, and the outbreak declined in weeks 11–12 (9–22 March).

PN0Rq6_CAAlP3iIxdkngnA.zh: 亞洲國家第14週(3/30-4/5)疫情,新加坡疫情上升,平均單日新增43例病例,已連續2週增加,且高於去年同期(19例);日本疫情處相對低點,定醫平均病例數0.04,較前週減少;韓國處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.6‰,與前週持平;香港第15週(4/6-4/12)就診陽性率為0.1‰,為今年最低點。
PN0Rq6_CAAlP3iIxdkngnA.en: Update on Asian countries for week 14 (30 March–5 April): Singapore's outbreak is rising, with an average of 43 new cases per day, up for two consecutive weeks and higher than the 19 cases in the same period last year. Japan's outbreak is at a relatively low point, with an average sentinel clinic case count of 0.04, down from the previous week. South Korea is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.6‰, unchanged from the previous week. Hong Kong's clinic-visit positivity rate in week 15 (6–12 April) was 0.1‰, the lowest this year.

Xs7ZeriffF_Kh5KTIuSg3w.zh: 韓國於第14週(3/30-4/5) 類流感門診就診率為16.9‰,已連續4週上升,且高於閾(8.6‰),疫情仍持續上升中,此波疫情以學齡兒童及青少年(7-18歲)感染率最高,近期主要流行型別為B型,當局呼籲家長及學校加強衛教及呼吸道感染防護,並儘速接種疫苗。
Xs7ZeriffF_Kh5KTIuSg3w.en: In week 14 (30 March–5 April), South Korea's influenza-like illness outpatient visit rate was 16.9‰, rising for four consecutive weeks and above the epidemic threshold of 8.6‰. The outbreak is still rising. This wave has the highest infection rate among school-age children and adolescents (aged 7–18). The main type circulating recently is influenza B. Authorities urge parents and schools to strengthen health education and respiratory infection protection, and to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

SZnUpQ09Ia3HfJy1Tif9lg.zh: 韓國公布2024年結核病報告,全年報告1.7萬餘例(35.2例/10萬人),較前一年減少8.2%,高齡及外籍患者數量減少,惟占比逐年上升,該國病例數自2011年達高峰後,已連續13年下降,年均下降7.6%。
SZnUpQ09Ia3HfJy1Tif9lg.en: South Korea has published its 2024 tuberculosis report. Over 17,000 cases were reported for the full year (35.2 per 100,000 people), a decrease of 8.2% from the previous year. The number of elderly and foreign patients fell, but their share has risen each year. Cases have declined for 13 consecutive years since peaking in 2011, with an average annual decline of 7.6%.

4eARB-eyLalV2EeoFCzUOw.zh: 多國疫情持續:  韓國自去年12月迄今報告18例,其中13例為境外移入,病例皆來自越南;香港報告今年首例,為越南境外移入個案;日本第10週(3/6-12)新增12例,新增病例數為今年以來新高,累計報告22例,其中15例為境外移入,感染國家以越南(10例)為多,近期發現數例未有境外旅遊史個案,該國將於4月舉行大型博覽會,海外遊客眾多,呼籲加強相關防疫措施。 美國中南部疫情持續,截至3/18累計報告317例(德州279例/新墨西哥州38例),其中38例住院,2例死亡,另鄰近奧克拉荷馬州報告4例與此次疫情相關病例,該國今年截至3/13共15州報告301例,並於3/7發布麻疹疫情健康警示。 澳洲今年迄今報告29例,病例多來自維多利亞州及新南威爾斯州,兩州各報告13例,病例多為境外移入,感染國包含越南、印等國,該國2023-24年分別報告26及57例。
4eARB-eyLalV2EeoFCzUOw.en: Measles continues in several countries. South Korea has reported 18 cases since last December, 13 of them imported, all from Viet Nam. Hong Kong reported its first case this year, an imported case from Viet Nam. Japan added 12 cases in week 10 (6–12 March), the highest weekly number this year, bringing the cumulative total to 22, of which 15 were imported. Viet Nam is the most common source country, with 10 cases. Several recent cases had no overseas travel history. Japan will host a large expo in April with many overseas visitors, and authorities call for strengthened preventive measures. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 18 March, 317 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 279, New Mexico 38), of which 38 were hospitalized and 2 died. Neighbouring Oklahoma reported 4 cases related to this outbreak. As of 13 March, 15 states had reported 301 cases this year, and on 7 March the US issued a health alert on measles. Australia has reported 29 cases so far this year, mostly from Victoria and New South Wales, with 13 cases in each. Most cases are imported, from countries including Viet Nam and India. Australia reported 26 cases in 2023 and 57 in 2024.

RyNpkJzk57rnQ88DLZ0WCg.zh: 愛爾蘭西南部於去年新增該區首例確診病例,為30多歲男性,出生並成長於加勒比海國家,移居至愛爾蘭逾10年,2023年底出現右臂麻木疼痛等症狀,去年夏季確診,已康復出院。當局將加強醫護專業訓練;該國10年內累計5例病例。 韓國報告去年全年累計5例病例,皆為外國籍人士,該國自2019-23年每年新增病例數介於2-5例,多為外國人士,爰增加外國人免費篩檢次數;2023年全球約182,815例病例,其中東南亞地區佔7成。
RyNpkJzk57rnQ88DLZ0WCg.en: In southwestern Ireland, the region recorded its first confirmed case last year: a man in his 30s who was born and raised in a Caribbean country and had lived in Ireland for over 10 years. He developed numbness and pain in his right arm at the end of 2023, was confirmed last summer, and has recovered and been discharged. Authorities will strengthen professional training for healthcare workers. Ireland has recorded 5 cases over the past 10 years. South Korea reported 5 cases for the whole of last year, all in foreign nationals. Annual new cases in South Korea from 2019 to 2023 ranged from 2 to 5, mostly among foreigners, so the number of free screenings for foreigners has been increased. Globally, about 182,815 cases were reported in 2023, 70% of them in South-East Asia.

nUHEhyX9jvXXqfbiEX9_Sg.zh: 美國CDC公布荷美郵輪鹿特丹號(Rotterdam)腹瀉群聚事件,航程介於2/2-14,全船3,583人,其中119人(含12名船員)出現嘔吐及腹瀉症狀。 韓國公布今年第4週單週報告病例數469例病例,為近10年最高,逾半數為0-6歲嬰幼兒(51.4%),7-18歲族群佔2成,自去年第43週開始迄今,GII.17型之檢出率最高,而自今年1月起,GII.4型的檢出率也呈上升趨勢。
nUHEhyX9jvXXqfbiEX9_Sg.en: The US CDC reported a diarrhoea outbreak on the Holland America Line cruise ship Rotterdam, sailing from 2 to 14 February. A total of 3,583 people were on board, and 119 people, including 12 crew members, developed vomiting and diarrhoea. South Korea reported 469 cases in week 4 of this year, the highest weekly figure in 10 years. Over half were infants and young children aged 0–6 (51.4%), and 20% were aged 7–18. From week 43 of last year to date, genotype GII.17 has had the highest detection rate, and since January this year the detection rate of GII.4 has also been rising.

GGLcaxU6pnUj2RGobnkLAQ.zh: 韓國已連續4週病例數降至閾以下,第4週(1/19-1/25)報告113例,該國自2023年冬季呈現上升趨勢,於去年8月達到高峰(1,179例)後呈下降趨勢,並於11月後顯著下降,目前已降至閾以下,故解除疫情警示。
GGLcaxU6pnUj2RGobnkLAQ.en: South Korea's Mycoplasma pneumoniae case numbers have been below the threshold for four consecutive weeks. In week 4 (19–25 January), 113 cases were reported. The country's activity has risen since winter 2023 and peaked in August last year at 1,179 cases, then declined and fell markedly after November. Case numbers are now below the threshold, so the epidemic alert has been lifted.

G3v8_rRHemtXNeSMgyoeFA.zh: 美國德州西部蓋恩斯郡(Gaines County)爆發疫情,累計報告24例,其中9例住院,多數病例為學齡兒童,此波疫情可能與當地學校群聚相關,目前仍調查中。另該郡因某些因素,兒童接種率較低,且當地有許多自學學童,實際未接種數可能更高,當局已推動疫苗接種活動。 越南於去年報告45,550例疑病例,其中超過7,500例確診及16例死亡,約25%確診病例為9個月以下嬰幼兒,WHO已將該國疫情風險評估為非常高,該國已展開全國疫苗接種活動。 韓國濟州島報告5年來首例病例,病患於1/22入境該國前具越南旅遊史,目前相關接觸者無症狀,該國今年累計報告3例,皆為境外移入。
G3v8_rRHemtXNeSMgyoeFA.en: Gaines County in West Texas, USA, has an outbreak with 24 cumulative cases, of which 9 were hospitalized. Most patients are school-age children. The outbreak may be linked to school clusters locally, and the investigation is ongoing. Child vaccination coverage in the county is low for several reasons, and there are many homeschooled children, so the actual number of unvaccinated children may be higher. Authorities have promoted vaccination campaigns. Viet Nam reported 45,550 suspected cases last year, of which over 7,500 were confirmed and 16 died. About 25% of confirmed cases were infants under 9 months old. WHO has assessed the outbreak risk in Viet Nam as very high, and the country has launched a nationwide vaccination campaign. South Korea's Jeju Island reported its first case in five years. The patient had a travel history to Viet Nam before entering South Korea on 22 January. Contacts are currently asymptomatic. South Korea has reported 3 cases this year, all imported.

kvyDeUkW3mxp8KOffhLNOw.zh: 日本第4週(1/20-1/26)報告5.4萬餘例,定醫門診平均病例數11.06例,該國於2024年52週報告逾31萬例(定醫平均病例數64.39例)達高峰後,病例數呈下降趨勢。近期病例數以山形縣、新潟縣及石川縣為多,部分地區仍有病床不足情形,專家表示近期新增病例數雖趨緩,惟須留意B型流感可能取代A型流感,亦應注意新冠等傳染病,呼籲民眾仍需採取防護措施。 韓國第4週(1/19-1/25)流感門診就診率為36.5‰,該國於今年第1週(2024/12/29-2025/1/4)就診率99.8‰達高峰後呈下降趨勢,惟目前仍高於閾,當局密切監測春節假期期間流感及呼吸道傳染病情形。
kvyDeUkW3mxp8KOffhLNOw.en: Japan reported over 54,000 cases in week 4 (20–26 January), with an average of 11.06 cases per sentinel clinic. After peaking in week 52 of 2024 with over 310,000 cases (an average of 64.39 per sentinel clinic), case numbers have been declining. Recent cases are concentrated in Yamagata, Niigata and Ishikawa prefectures, and some areas still have insufficient hospital beds. Experts say that although new cases have slowed, attention should be paid to influenza B possibly replacing influenza A, and COVID-19 and other infectious diseases should also be monitored; the public is urged to continue taking protective measures. South Korea's influenza outpatient visit rate in week 4 (19–25 January) was 36.5‰. After peaking at 99.8‰ in week 1 of this year (29 December 2024–4 January 2025), the rate has declined but remains above the threshold, and authorities are closely monitoring influenza and respiratory infections during the Lunar New Year holiday.

VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.zh: 多國疫情上升,病例數高於歷年同期:  亞洲:中國去(2024)年報告49萬餘例,為2023年14倍,近期疫情已趨緩,病例數已降至單月1萬例以下;韓國去年報告逾4.7萬例,今(2025)年迄今報告已逾1,600例,遠高於往年單年不超過千例水平;日本病例數持續上升,近期處高點,惟疫情仍低於新冠疫情前規模;越南去年報告1,000餘例,為2023年21.9倍。 大洋洲:澳洲於去年報告逾5.7萬例病例,為2023年23.3倍,今年初疫情持續,迄今累計報告逾3,000例;紐西蘭自去年10月中旬迄今累計報告1,200餘例,其中101例住院,1例死亡。 美洲:美國去年累計報告3.5萬餘例,為2023年同期的6倍,近期病例數呈上升趨勢;巴西去年報告逾6,000例,為2014年以來新高。
VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.en: Several countries have seen rising case numbers, above same-period levels in previous years. Asia: China reported over 490,000 cases last year (2024), 14 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak has recently eased, and monthly cases have fallen below 10,000. South Korea reported over 47,000 cases last year, and so far this year (2025) more than 1,600 cases, far above the level of previous years, when no single year exceeded 1,000 cases. Japan's case numbers continue to rise and are currently near a peak, although the outbreak remains below the scale seen before the COVID-19 pandemic. Viet Nam reported over 1,000 cases last year, 21.9 times the 2023 figure. Oceania: Australia reported over 57,000 cases last year, 23.3 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak continued into early this year, with over 3,000 cases reported so far. New Zealand has reported over 1,200 cases cumulatively since mid-October last year, of which 101 were hospitalised and 1 died. Americas: The United States reported over 35,000 cases last year, six times the same period of 2023, and case numbers are rising. Brazil reported over 6,000 cases last year, the highest since 2014.

qT8Mj2O9JYUl31LZ_Zo2dA.zh: 韓國近期監測顯示HMPV住院數上升,其中以0-6歲占48.6%為多,其次為65歲以上族群(20.4%)及7-12歲兒童(18.2%),檢出率從第49週3.2%上升至52週之5.3%,當局表示目前仍低於閾。 新加坡HMPV病例數上升,於2024年12月,社區之ARI樣本中之HMPV病例占比由0.8%上升至9%,惟趨勢與往年一致,研判為年底社交聚會和假期旅行增加所致;馬來西亞2024年報告327例HMPV病例,較2023年增加45%。
qT8Mj2O9JYUl31LZ_Zo2dA.en: South Korea's recent surveillance shows rising hMPV hospitalisations, with the largest share among children aged 0–6 (48.6%), followed by people aged 65 and over (20.4%) and children aged 7–12 (18.2%). The detection rate rose from 3.2% in week 49 to 5.3% in week 52, and authorities state that it remains below the threshold. Singapore: hMPV cases have risen. In December 2024, the share of hMPV among acute respiratory infection (ARI) samples from the community rose from 0.8% to 9%. However, the trend is consistent with previous years, and authorities attribute it to increased social gatherings and holiday travel at the end of the year. Malaysia reported 327 hMPV cases in 2024, an increase of 45% over 2023.

wglWVAE3HrdWe1HTRmoVIQ.zh: 韓國疫情上升,去年累計報告6,762例病例,高於前年(2023年)5,926例,去年52週新增291例,病患近6成為0-6歲幼兒;香港疫情上升,去年12/22-28新增報告7例病例,於12/29-2025/1/4則新增19例,多集中於安養機構,當局呼籲加強衛生措施。
wglWVAE3HrdWe1HTRmoVIQ.en: South Korea: Cases are rising. Last year, 6,762 cases were reported cumulatively, higher than the 5,926 cases in the previous year (2023). In week 52 of last year, 291 new cases were reported, and nearly 60% of patients are children aged 0–6. Hong Kong: Cases are rising. From 22 to 28 December last year, 7 new cases were reported, and from 29 December 2024 to 4 January 2025, 19 new cases were reported, mostly concentrated in elderly care facilities. Authorities urge strengthened hygiene measures.

Tvyi6qH8MyrDsJBZfeZJlQ.zh: 越南去年全年累計逾3.8萬例疑病例,其中確診逾6,700例,相較2023年確診數已逾百倍,死亡13例,多數病例來自南部地區,惟北部地區病例數亦呈上升趨勢,有持續擴散趨勢;韓國去年全年累計報告49例,病例皆為境外移入及其接觸病例,感染國家多為中亞及東南亞地區。
Tvyi6qH8MyrDsJBZfeZJlQ.en: Viet Nam reported more than 38,000 suspected cases last year, of which over 6,700 were confirmed, more than 100 times the number confirmed in 2023, with 13 deaths. Most cases came from the southern region, but case numbers in the northern region are also rising, indicating continued spread. South Korea reported 49 cases in total last year; all were imported cases or their contacts, and most infections were acquired in Central Asia and Southeast Asia.

APSOZPkS81oiS2anwdTqAw.zh: 日本於去年第51週(12/16-12/22)累計報告21.1萬餘例,定醫門診平均病例數42.66例,為10年來最高,全國有36個都道府縣超過警報標準,該國病例數快速上升,第51週病例數為前1週2倍以上,評估病例將持續增加;韓國第52週類流感門診就診率為73.9 ‰,較前1週31.3‰顯著上升,當局於去年12/20發布警報,並呼籲民眾儘速接種疫苗。
APSOZPkS81oiS2anwdTqAw.en: Japan's cumulative reports in week 51 of last year (16–22 December) exceeded 211,000 cases, with an average of 42.66 cases per sentinel clinic, the highest in 10 years. Thirty-six prefectures nationwide exceeded the alert threshold. Japan's case numbers are rising rapidly: the number in week 51 was more than double that of the previous week, and the assessment is that cases will continue to rise. South Korea's influenza-like illness outpatient visit rate in week 52 was 73.9‰, a significant increase from 31.3‰ the previous week. Authorities issued an alert on 20 December last year and urge the public to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

EU1zB9PvZ2o0Vbah9_KlzQ.zh: 韓國公布今年度腸道寄生蟲感染調查,調查顯示整體腸道寄生蟲感染率為4.5%,其中致癌性病原肝吸蟲感染率為2.3%,較去年略有上升,但整體仍呈下降趨勢,以肝吸蟲2.3%感染率為高,另部分地區感染率仍高於10%,當局表示仍需持續針對當地飲食習慣進行衛教。
EU1zB9PvZ2o0Vbah9_KlzQ.en: South Korea has published its survey of intestinal parasitic infections for this year. The survey shows an overall intestinal parasite infection rate of 4.5%. The infection rate for liver fluke, a carcinogenic pathogen, was 2.3%, slightly higher than last year, although the overall trend is still declining. Liver fluke had the highest infection rate at 2.3%, and infection rates in some regions remain above 10%. Authorities say continued health education tailored to local dietary habits is still needed.

ModzAc7IuVDp0NIBIySk5w.zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第44週(11/4-11/10)全球陽性率約14.6%,陽性率以歐洲區(18.7%)、美洲區(10.2%)及非洲區(4.4%)為高。 韓國近期處低點,新增病例數及廢水樣本病毒量皆處低點,該國調整治療藥物瑞德西韋(Remdesivir)的處方標準,將年齡限制提高到70歲以上。 紐西蘭陽性率近期處低點,截至10/27陽性率約4.9%;廢水監測顯示近期XEC變異株占比逐漸上升,目前該國主流株為KP.3,其次為JN.1及XEC。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期略升,其中,西太平洋區上升;歐洲區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
ModzAc7IuVDp0NIBIySk5w.en:
Situation update: In week 44 of 2024 (4–10 November), the global positivity rate was about 14.6%, highest in the European Region (18.7%), the Region of the Americas (10.2%) and the African Region (4.4%).

South Korea's indicators are at low levels: both new cases and viral load in wastewater samples are low. The country has revised the prescribing criteria for the treatment drug remdesivir, raising the age limit to over 70 years.

New Zealand's positivity rate is currently at a low level; as of 27 October it was about 4.9%. Wastewater surveillance shows that the share of XEC variants has gradually increased recently. The dominant strain in the country is currently KP.3, followed by JN.1 and XEC.

Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has risen slightly recently, with an increase in the Western Pacific Region and a slight rise in the European Region; other regions show stable or declining trends. KP.3.1.1 remains the main circulating variant globally, and the share of XEC variants is increasing, but this has not yet increased disease severity. WHO notes that most countries have now included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, keep tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure built during the COVID-19 period.

f9EYEdSju18d9yx1fovYBQ.zh: 拉脫維亞疫情升高,9月單月新增680例病例,且發病率仍持續上升,今年迄今累計報告2,517例,其中1例死亡;該國去年僅報告112例。 韓國11/12報告今年首例死亡病例,為未滿2個月嬰兒,於接種首劑疫苗前即感染;該國今年疫情嚴峻,累計報告30,332例疑病例,遠高於新冠疫情前規模(單年千例以下),病例分布於全國,多發生於7至19歲青少年,當局呼籲高風險族群按時接種疫苗。
f9EYEdSju18d9yx1fovYBQ.en:
Latvia's outbreak is rising. In September alone, 680 new cases were reported, and incidence continues to climb. This year, 2,517 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 1 death; the country reported only 112 cases last year.

South Korea reported its first death this year on 12 November, in an infant under 2 months old who was infected before receiving the first dose of vaccine. The outbreak in the country this year is severe, with 30,332 suspected cases cumulatively reported, far above the pre-COVID-19 level of fewer than 1,000 cases per year. Cases are distributed nationwide, mostly among adolescents aged 7 to 19. Authorities urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated on schedule.

iHfsobAvwTT86Z23JkMaZw.zh: 韓國今年疫情上升,截至10/12累計報告25,365例病例,整體疫情於7月達高峰(每週3千餘例)後趨緩,目前每週仍持續報告1千餘例病例;當局表示病患近9成為青少年,已加強中學生族群接種加強劑疫苗。
iHfsobAvwTT86Z23JkMaZw.en: Pertussis is rising in South Korea this year. As of 12 October, 25,365 cases have been cumulatively reported. Overall, the outbreak peaked in July, with more than 3,000 cases weekly, and then eased; more than 1,000 cases are still being reported each week. Authorities say nearly 90% of patients are adolescents, and have stepped up booster vaccination for middle school students.
